paper.title_en: Black hole entropy from angular holonomies of Sine-Gordon soliton lattices in AdS$_3$
paper.abstract_en: We construct boundary conditions for AdS$_3$ gravity that realize Sine-Gordon dynamics. For a periodic soliton lattice at fixed winding, we relate the angular holonomy to the exact acoustic dispersion by continuing the Bloch momentum through the zero-frequency band edge associated with rigid translation of the lattice. For suitable embedding angles, the stable vacuum has a regular BTZ geometry. When only one chiral sector carries winding, we construct a family whose asymptotic region extends to a BTZ black hole. As the spectral parameter of the winding sector tends to the corresponding band edge, the black hole approaches extremality. The leading correction to the extremal entropy is linear in the Hawking temperature defined with respect to laboratory time, with a coefficient inversely proportional to the sound velocity of the lattice. The same inverse-velocity dependence appears in the low-temperature entropy of one-dimensional quantum fluids.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在 AdS₃ 引力中构造实现 Sine-Gordon 动力学的边界条件，将角 holonomy 与声学色散联系起来，并在单手征绕数情形下构造趋近极端的 BTZ 黑洞，给出与声速成反比的极端熵修正，属于黑洞热力学与引力理论基础交叉的深入理论研究，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: AdS$_3$ 中 Sine-Gordon 孤子晶格角 holonomy 给出的黑洞熵
decision.abstract_zh: 我们构造了实现 Sine-Gordon 动力学的 AdS$_3$ 引力边界条件。对于固定绕数下的周期孤子晶格，我们通过将 Bloch 动量延拓穿过与晶格刚性平移相关联的零频率带边，把角 holonomy 与精确的声学色散联系起来。对于合适的嵌入角，稳定真空具有规则的 BTZ 几何。当仅有一个手征扇区携带绕数时，我们构造了一族其渐近区域延伸至 BTZ 黑洞的解。当绕数扇区的谱参数趋于相应的带边时，黑洞趋近极端性。对极端熵的首阶修正与相对于实验室时间定义的 Hawking 温度成线性关系，其系数与晶格声速成反比。同样的反比速度依赖也出现在一维量子流体的低温熵中。
